name.description: kebab-case slug, unique across the whole knowledge base

description.description: one-line summary used for search results and indices

source.description: where this came from: URL, session reference, person

due.description: prospective entries only: when this intention should fire

archived.description: when this entry was retired from retrieval; it stays readable and stays in the graph

authority.description: optional: mark an entry that reads with imperative force as a non-negotiable 'rule' (violating it breaks something) or an overridable 'preference' (a working choice), so retrieval can carry the difference forward. Leave unset for entries that are neither — most facts, procedures, and logs.
